usedFor: Modern Events Calendar holds your events, and Telegram announces them when “New Event” runs “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Event” in Modern Events Calendar, then “Send Message” in Telegram
bestTemplate.why: A newly created event is posted to a Telegram chat, so followers hear about it without a manual announcement.

watchOut: “New Event” in Modern Events Calendar is polling, so the Telegram post follows a scheduled check.
